counter_unit: One actually covered frontend head-cycle, dedup once(cycle,request_uid), and its same-instant target-set ways; not unique requests or global set-time.

histograms.heads_raw_reserved_eligible: [raw,r,e] -> head-cycle count, runtime present only; e is structural eligibility, operational eligibility additionally requires T
histograms.heads_raw_reserved_reasonmask: [raw,r,5bit mask] -> head-cycle count, independent presence of eligible/notAttached/reuse/noMissing/noLive in SAME set at SAME instant
histograms.ways_raw_reserved_predmask: [raw,r,3bit predicate] -> live-RO way observations; full attached/reuse/missing overlap retained
histograms.heads_raw_reserved_eligible_route_admit: [raw,r,eligiblePresent,actualProductionRoute,admitted] -> head-cycle count, runtime present only; same exact head snapshot with real preview outcomes, not inferred marginal product

NA_rules: skipped TVD/ideal/disabled/other: NO raw/ways/eligibility zero bins; maintain reason count and explicitly NA
head absent: absent-cycle only, not covered head
runtime off: Tag occupancy valid but RO eligibility/predicate is NA
T off: structural RO predicate observed; operational detach disabled; never label eligible actionable
sampling: all covered head-cycles; no random sampling; no bounded example log required
note: Wire serialization and model integration in isolated_hooks.patch.txt are review drafts; no production Q/source/binary authority is claimed.
